def _rewrite_list_item(tok: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    # Get the raw text from the first child if it exists
    if tok.get('children'):
        first_child = tok['children'][0]
        if first_child.get('type') == 'paragraph':
            # Get the text content from the paragraph
            if first_child.get('children'):
                text_child = first_child['children'][0]
                if text_child.get('type') == 'text':
                    raw_text = text_child.get('raw', '')
                    match = TASK_LIST_ITEM.match(raw_text)
                    if match:
                        # This is a task list item
                        checkbox = match.group(1)
                        checked = checkbox.lower() == '[x]'
                        
                        # Remove the checkbox from the text
                        new_text = raw_text[match.end():]
                        text_child['raw'] = new_text
                        
                        # Mark this as a task list item
                        tok['type'] = 'task_list_item'
                        tok['checked'] = checked
